crop.window: 2*pitch wide x 1*pitch tall centred on the gap, step = pitch/16
crop.sample: crop px (i,j) <- centre + ((i+0.5-16)*ex + (j+0.5-8)*ey) * pitch/16; image pixel k centre at k+0.5; bilinear, clamp
crop.v_pair: centre ((col+0.5)P, (row+1)P), ex=(0,1), ey=(-1,0) (upper stud on the left)

trained_on: synthetic crops (ml/dataset.py) then fine-tuned (ml/finetune.py) on 16 labelled real photos (fixtures real + closeup, 7221 pairs, x9 with jittered re-crops) mixed 50/50 with synthetic; pipeline pre-blur 0.5 crop px
val_note: val_acc/same_colour_val_acc = held-out synthetic mosaics; real_oof_* = 4-fold mosaic-grouped CV on exact pipeline crops of the 16 labelled photos
